Description: NREL ATB scenario selection. ATB carries every (scenario, model_case) for each carrier — these settings choose which slice ``load_costs`` uses.
Global default ATB cost trajectory. ``Advanced`` = optimistic / fastest cost decline; ``Conservative`` = pessimistic. See :ref:`data-costs`.
Global default. ``Market`` bakes current policy incentives (PTC/ITC) into financing; ``R&D`` strips them out for a pure-learning view.

Optional per-carrier overrides. Keys are pypsa-names (``solar``, ``onwind``, ``nuclear``, ``CCGT``, ``4hr_battery_storage``, …); each value may set ``scenario`` and/or ``model_case``. Anything unset falls back to the global default.
AEO case used to fetch projected fuel costs for the requested year.
Discount rate used for weighting multi-investment objective function values.
Share of rooftop PV when calculating capital cost of solar (joint rooftop and utility-scale PV).
